@graph.headline: DTF vs Screen Printing: Understanding the Differences, Benefits and Applications
@graph.description: Sooner or later, everyone who orders custom T-shirts runs into the same question: DTF vs screen printing, which one should I go for? Both methods can give you a sharp, good-looking print, but they work very differently, cost differently and suit different kinds of orders.

@graph.headline: How Custom Printed T-Shirts Help Businesses Build Brand Identity
@graph.description: Walk into a busy café, an exhibition stall or a corporate office and notice what you remember afterwards. It is rarely the brochure on the counter. It is the person wearing the logo. Custom printed T-shirts for business turn everyday clothing into a small billboard that people see, remember and talk about.

@graph.headline: How DTF Printing Technology Is Transforming the Custom Apparel Industry
@graph.description: Ask anyone who has tried to start a small clothing brand a few years back, and you will hear the same story. The designs were ready, the idea was solid, but the printing costs ate everything. Screen printing wanted big quantities, and most other options either looked dull or washed out after a few cycles.

@graph.headline: UV DTF Printing: How It Works and Its Applications in Product Branding
@graph.description: Pick up a premium-looking water bottle or a café mug these days and run your thumb over the logo. Chances are it feels slightly raised, glossy, and almost moulded into the surface. Most people assume that kind of finish needs expensive manufacturing. In reality, it is often UV DTF printing, a method that has quietly changed how small and mid-sized brands put their name on products.

@graph.headline: Different T-Shirt Printing Techniques: A Complete Guide for Businesses
@graph.description: If you run a business, sooner or later you will need printed T-shirts. Maybe it is a uniform for your staff, merchandise for a launch, gifts for a corporate event, or a small clothing line of your own. And the moment you start asking for quotes, you run into a confusing list: screen printing, DTF, DTG, heat transfer, sublimation, vinyl, embroidery. Every printer swears by a different one, which makes choosing between T-shirt printing techniques harder than it should be.

mainEntity.name: What is OrderPrintex and what printing services do you manufacture?

acceptedAnswer.text: OrderPrintex is a premier manufacturing facility and bulk printing studio based in New Delhi, India. We specialize in industrial-grade Direct-to-Film (DTF) apparel transfers, UV DTF multi-surface transfer decals, custom screen-quality t-shirt printing, and turnkey corporate promotional kits. We cater to apparel brands, promotional agencies, screen printers, and independent creators across India.

mainEntity.name: Do you serve B2B clients, print studios, and wholesale resellers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! A significant portion of our daily production is dedicated to job-work and white-label wholesale supply for screen printing studios, DTG printers, uniform manufacturers, and retail clothing brands. We provide rolls and gang sheets ready for you to press and distribute to your own customers.

mainEntity.name: Which file formats can I upload for printing?

acceptedAnswer.text: We accept high-resolution files in Transparent PNG (300 DPI, recommended for single designs and gang sheets), vector Adobe Illustrator (.ai), EPS (.eps), layered Adobe Photoshop (.psd at 300 DPI), and print-ready vector PDF with embedded fonts.

mainEntity.name: How do I submit my artwork and prepare transparent backgrounds?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can upload artwork directly through the Upload Your Design workbench on our Homepage, on our Service pages, or via the Get a Quote form. Ensure your artwork has transparent negative spaces wherever you do not want white ink backing to print. If you submit a JPEG with a white background, that white square will print as solid opaque white ink.

mainEntity.name: Can I request a digital design proof before production begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, absolutely. Every order undergoes rigorous prepress review by our color technicians. We verify resolution, line thickness, color gamut, and bleed margins. For custom projects, digital mockups and RIP proofs are shared via the client portal for formal approval before physical printing starts.

mainEntity.name: What is DTF printing and which fabrics does it bond to?

acceptedAnswer.text: DTF (Direct-to-Film) is a cutting-edge digital garment decoration technique. Artwork is printed onto specialized PET release film using high-density CMYK textile inks plus a solid white underbase, followed by a layer of hot-melt polyurethane adhesive powder cured under heat. DTF transfers apply flawlessly to virtually any fabric: 100% cotton, combed cotton, 100% polyester, poly-cotton blends, fleece, denim, nylon, canvas, and performance spandex.

mainEntity.name: What is the recommended heat press setting for DTF transfers?

acceptedAnswer.text: For optimal washability and soft-hand feel: 1) Pre-press garment 3-5 seconds to remove moisture. 2) Transfer Press at 160°C (320°F) for 15 seconds under medium-to-firm pressure (40-50 PSI / 4-5 bar). 3) Cold Peel: Allow the transfer to cool completely to room temperature, then peel PET film smoothly. 4) Post-press: Cover graphic with Teflon or silicone parchment paper and press for 5 seconds to seal the transfer into the weave.

mainEntity.name: How do I wash DTF-printed garments to ensure 50+ wash longevity?

acceptedAnswer.text: Turn garments inside-out, wash in cold or lukewarm water (max 30°C / 85°F) with mild detergent, avoid bleach or harsh spot removers, tumble dry on gentle low heat or hang dry in shade, and never iron directly on the printed graphic.

mainEntity.name: What is UV DTF printing and how does it work?

acceptedAnswer.text: UV DTF is an innovative cold-transfer technology engineered specifically for hard, non-porous surfaces. Using piezoelectric printheads, the printer deposits white ink, vibrant CMYK inks, and a high-gloss 3D tactile clear varnish, cured instantaneously by ultraviolet LED lamps. Prints are applied directly to products without heat presses or ovens: peel, align, rub firmly, and peel away the carrier film.

mainEntity.name: Which surfaces are compatible with UV DTF transfer stickers?

acceptedAnswer.text: UV DTF stickers bond permanently to clean, rigid, and smooth or lightly contoured materials including glassware, stainless steel tumblers, aluminum water flasks, ceramic mugs, plastics, acrylics, cell phone cases, rigid electronics, lacquered wood, and cosmetic packaging.

mainEntity.name: Are UV DTF decals waterproof, scratch-resistant, and dishwasher safe?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Because inks are cross-linked under high-intensity UV LED light and sealed with a heavy clear spot varnish layer, UV DTF stickers are 100% waterproof, UV-resistant, and scratch-resistant under normal handling. For maximum longevity on drinkware, hand-washing with a soft sponge is recommended.

mainEntity.name: Can I order custom T-shirts and what garment qualities are available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! We offer complete end-to-end t-shirt manufacturing and printing. Clients can supply their own blanks or choose from our factory inventory: 180 GSM bio-washed combed cotton, 240 GSM heavyweight oversized streetwear tees, dry-fit sports polyester jerseys, and pique knit corporate polo shirts.

mainEntity.name: Where can graphics be placed on custom t-shirts?

acceptedAnswer.text: We support Left Chest pocket prints, Center Chest, Full Front (up to 12x16 inches), Full Back (up to 12x18 inches), Left/Right Sleeve branding, and interior neck custom brand labels. Multiple positions can be combined on a single run.

mainEntity.name: Can I build gang sheets with mixed logos, neck tags, and artwork sizes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! On our 22-inch roll gang sheets, you can arrange dozens of different logos, neck labels, chest graphics, and sleeve designs on a single roll with no per-design setup fees. You only pay for the total linear length of the gang roll.

mainEntity.name: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)?

acceptedAnswer.text: For DTF gang sheets, you can order from as little as 1 meter roll. For custom printed t-shirts and corporate merchandise, single prototype samples are available before committing to bulk production runs of 50, 500, or 5,000+ units.

mainEntity.name: How can I request a quotation for my printing project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Submit your artwork and required dimensions via our online Get a Quote form, upload via the homepage design tool, or contact our sales team via WhatsApp (+91 93540 28199). Prepress coordinators calculate optimal sheet yield and provide an itemized formal quotation with transparent per-unit and volume tiered pricing.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer tiered discounts for continuous gang rolls and bulk orders?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Commercial printers and brand owners who order recurring volume or continuous rolls (10m, 25m, 50m, 100m+) receive preferential trade wholesale pricing. Contact our Delhi facility to set up a dedicated B2B trade account.

mainEntity.name: How can I track my order once dispatched?

acceptedAnswer.text: Once your order passes our final quality control inspection, it is packaged in heavy-duty moisture-resistant protective tubes or corrugated mailers. Dispatch details and tracking links (Blue Dart, DTDC, Delhivery, or India Post Speed Post) are updated in your customer portal and notified via WhatsApp or Email.

mainEntity.name: What is your standard turnaround time for gang sheets and printed merchandise?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard production for approved DTF gang sheets and UV DTF decals is typically 24 to 48 hours. Finished custom t-shirts and bulk promotional merchandise take 3 to 5 business days depending on volume. Expedited same-day dispatch from our New Delhi hub is available for urgent rush orders upon request.
